correctness.rationale: With reciprocal attacks, stability is independent domination, or maximal independence. The local binary conditions correctly enforce both endpoints. Independently used a three-state word automaton tracking the last selection and zero run, with initial state permitting one leading zero and acceptance permitting one trailing zero (including the empty input). Its ordered tensor-square transfer has denominator degree at most nine and numerator degree at most eight; after cross-multiplication with the claimed N/D the numerator degree is at most fourteen. All coefficients through this bound agree exactly; this proves the all-length identity, not just a finite check. At full distance, independence of both complementary sets and connectivity force the two alternating assignments. At distance one, inclusion would contradict maximality. Independently, for a selected site, the allowed words on either side have length series (1+x)/(1-x^2-x^3): interselection gaps are two or three and the outer zero run is zero or one. The full nonempty word series is x(1+x)^2/(1-x^2-x^3). Its unique dominant simple pole h=1/lambda yields a bulk inclusion probability p=1/(2h^2+3h^3)=(lambda+1)/(2lambda+3), with geometric errors in the distances to the endpoints. Summing 2p_i(1-p_i) for independent uniform draws therefore gives 2p(1-p)n+O(1), with the stated coefficient 0.4843339383476568... .
residual_risks: Scope is labelled bidirected paths, ordered pairs of stable extensions, and independent uniform sampling for the mean.

evidence: Stable extensions here are maximal independent sets, also called independent dominating sets. For a fixed Hamming indeterminate z, use the linear average of signs t with weights (1+z)/2 at +1 and (1-z)/2 at -1. Then E[t^a t^b]=z^{a xor b} for bits a,b, so P_n(z)=E[W_n(t_1,...,t_n)^2] for independent coordinates. This is a formal polynomial identity even though the weights are probabilities only on a real subinterval.

Direct tensor squaring and independent sign averaging in its published matrices gives the exact claimed N/D. This is demonstrated equivalent coverage by a mechanical specialization of the stronger signed transfer; the prior need not print the expanded numerator. The mean follows by differentiating this specialization and the two extremal facts are routine consequences of maximal independence on a path.

value.rationale: All-distance path diversity is a natural invariant and the explicit expression is a convenient presentation. However, it is the exact evaluation of a routine two-copy specialization of an existing fixed-size signed transfer, not an independently unknown exact invariant under the audit standard. The support endpoints follow by alternation and maximality and the mean is an immediate derived statistic of that exact specialization; no distinct substantive residual claim is established.
residual_risks: This is a scientific coverage/value decision, not an objection to the use of finite-state methods or to the correctness of the explicit formula.
